chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade continuous fasting in sawm.

And he used to continue the fast, so it was said to him about that, and he, peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, I am not like any one of you. Indeed, I remain with my Lord, and He feeds me and gives me drink.”

key_terms.عِنْدَ رَبِّي: in the presence of my Lord
key_terms.يُوَاصِلُ: he would continue the fast without interruption
key_terms.ٱلْوِصَالِ: continuous fasting without breaking the fast at night

ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله forbid continuous fasting while he himself practiced it?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله forbade al-wisal, meaning continuous fasting without breaking the fast at night. It also reports that his own state was unique, and that he explained this distinction by saying that his Lord fed him and gave him drink.
